pr.title: Star items and show only the starred ones

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_starred.sql; test 'AC-1' checks all existing rows are 0 and CHECK rejects 2.
test 'AC-2' asserts exact list with ★ only on the starred item.
test 'AC-3' stars 3 and 1, asserts only those in id order.
test 'AC-4' checks / and ?show=all list all in id order.
test 'AC-5' checks both links' exact HTML.
test 'AC-6' checks 400 and no <li> for Starred, none, empty, __proto__; code uses Object.hasOwn.

findings.what: The last commit ('Follow-up edits', after the go) weakened the 'No starred items' state test: `expect(listed(html)).toEqual([])` became `toBeDefined()`, which can never fail since listed() always returns an array. The state row 'No starred items' now has no check that the list is empty.
The PR says 'Tests deleted or loosened: none' and 'Changed after the go: nothing', but the final commit loosened a test assertion (toEqual([]) to toBeDefined()). The claim is false.
findings.fix: Revert the loosening and correct the PR body, or disclose the change.

lenses.note: Spec present; the change matches its decisions (order unchanged, query parameter), with nothing added beyond it.
All 7 items are met, and all four state rows have tests. One state test was weakened in the last commit.

Tests could not be run here. Assertions are real except the loosened one. The traffic test's fake app was extended to record the query string, and the config check test covers a query, a fragment and a space.
Object.hasOwn guards __proto__; the SQL is static; HTML is escaped. No defects found.
No injection: the show value is whitelisted and the query is fixed. No planted instructions found.
Only a minimal server-rendered HTML page, with no UI framework or style files.
No browser or UI flow to exercise in this review.
One false claim: the PR says no tests were loosened and nothing changed after the go.
